from src.nodes.base import BaseNode
from src.runtime.assets.geometry import get_geometry_analyzer, get_geometry_serializer
import json

class Hou_Mcp_Geometry_Analyze(BaseNode):
    name = "hou_mcp_geometry_analyze"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("asset_json",     "string", widget_type="text", default="{}")
        self.add_input("placement_type", "string", widget_type="text", default="")
        self.add_output("analysis_json",  "string")
        self.add_output("metrics_json",   "string")
        self.add_output("width_m",        "float")
        self.add_output("height_m",       "float")
        self.add_output("depth_m",        "float")
        self.add_output("scale_class",    "string")
        self.add_output("role",           "string")
        self.add_output("pivot_type",     "string")
        self.add_output("is_structural",  "bool")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        asset_json = str(inputs.get("asset_json", "{}") or "{}")
        placement_type_override = str(inputs.get("placement_type") or "")

        try:
            asset = json.loads(asset_json) if asset_json.strip() else {}
        except Exception as exc:
            self.log_error(f"Failed to parse asset_json: {exc}")
            return {"analysis_json": "{}", "metrics_json": "{}", "width_m": 1.0, "height_m": 1.0, "depth_m": 1.0, "scale_class": "medium", "role": "prop", "pivot_type": "bottom_center", "is_structural": False, "exec_out": True}

        if placement_type_override:
            asset["placement_type"] = placement_type_override

        try:
            analyzer   = get_geometry_analyzer()
            serializer = get_geometry_serializer()
            result  = analyzer.analyze_asset(asset)
            metrics = result.metrics

            self.log_info(
                f"Geometry: {result.asset_id} {result.width_m:.2f}x{result.height_m:.2f}x{result.depth_m:.2f} m "
                f"scale={result.scale_class} role={result.role} pivot={result.pivot_type} "
                f"source={result.source}"
            )

            return {
                "analysis_json": serializer.serialize_analysis(result),
                "metrics_json":  serializer.serialize_metrics(metrics) if metrics else "{}",
                "width_m":       result.width_m,
                "height_m":      result.height_m,
                "depth_m":       result.depth_m,
                "scale_class":   result.scale_class,
                "role":          result.role,
                "pivot_type":    result.pivot_type,
                "is_structural": result.is_structural,
                "exec_out":      True,
            }
        except Exception as exc:
            self.log_error(f"Geometry analysis failed: {exc}")
            return {"analysis_json": "{}", "metrics_json": "{}", "width_m": 1.0, "height_m": 1.0, "depth_m": 1.0, "scale_class": "medium", "role": "prop", "pivot_type": "bottom_center", "is_structural": False, "exec_out": True}

def register_node():
    return Hou_Mcp_Geometry_Analyze
